todos: [P2] FULLTASK-CLOSURE-EVIDENCE-01: after MILESTONE-RENAME-REMAP-01 (2026-09-23) scripts/live/fullTaskRun.live.ts with qwen2.5-coder:7b remapped m-6/m-7 to src/App.jsx after the directive rename and verified 7/7 milestones in 12/50 steps, but the run still fails its last assertion: the application closes 'unverifiable' because the generated React/Tailwind project only exposes npm run build (structural evidence), and the plan is thin (one src/App.jsx for both pages, no navigation, no services folder). Next, decide whether the scenario should require a behavioral check the plan must create (e.g. a smoke test milestone from planGenerationAppService) or accept 'unverifiable' with every milestone verified, and raise the plan-coverage bar for the task's required pages/navigation.

[P3] DOCUMENTS-LIST-PAYLOAD-01: GET /documents returns the full extracted_markdown of every document and useIngestedDocuments refetches it on every window focus and tab change; next, return metadata only from the list and load a document's markdown on demand (chat context, attach, translation).

[P3] I18N-HARDCODED-STRINGS-01: ~30 hardcoded Italian UI strings remain in src (e.g. AppLayout.tsx, ChatView.tsx, useCodingAgent.ts), 14 in Main core services, and sidecar progress/chunk-prefix text is Italian-only (the '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' prefix is also embedded); next, move UI strings to src/i18n locales and make sidecar progress messages locale-neutral codes.

[P3] MODEL-FALLBACK-CONSISTENCY-01: hardcoded model fallbacks disagree: 'qwen2.5-coder:7b' in agentInterviewAppService.ts, agentOrchestratorPromptAssembly.ts, agentOrchestratorSessionContext.ts, planGenerationAppService.ts versus 'llama3.2' in agentOrchestratorSessionSetup.ts::buildDefaultAgentSettings and ollamaHttpClient.ts, and 'qwen2.5-coder:7b' again in src/hooks/codingAgent/useCodingAgentExecution.ts (activeModel), plus Sidecar fallbacks to 'llama3.2' in sidecar/main.py (translate-inplace-stream model) and sidecar/domain/ingestion.py (normalization_model), while DEFAULT_APP_SETTINGS.defaultModel is ''. The Markdown translator already fails with translation.noModelConfigured instead of guessing (2026-09-23). Next, resolve a missing model in one shared function that fails with a clear 'no model configured' error instead of guessing a model that may not be installed.

[P3] RENDERER-PERF-01: ChatView.tsx renders messages without virtualization while useChatEngine re-maps the whole list every 40 ms during streaming; DiagnosticsDrawer polls full logs every 2.5 s with key={index}; PromptConfigurationModal tokenizes the whole draft on every keystroke and tokenEstimate.ts caches up to 1000 full drafts; monacoTheme.ts imports all of monaco-editor (ts.worker 6.9 MB). Next, memoize/virtualize the chat list, cap the token cache by size, debounce the token label, and load only the Monaco languages in use; verify with npm run test:e2e:bundle-ux.

[P3] LINT-STRICTNESS-01: biome.json lint uses preset none (only correctness + 3 suspicious rules); there are ~327 `any` in Main and ~130 in the renderer (97 are `catch (err: any)`), plus two inert `eslint-disable` comments (ESLint is not installed) in useAgentTimelineScroll.ts and useSkillHubModal.ts. After FORMAT-BASELINE-01, enable noExplicitAny as a warning, replace `catch (err: any)` with unknown + errorNormalizer, and delete the eslint-disable comments.

[P3] IPC-PLAN-CONTRACT-01: after the 2026-09-23 IPC contract audit, `agent:plan-generate` still validates previousPlan with a passthrough schema (formatVersion, id, version, prompt, objective) while planGenerationAppService reads previousPlan.milestones and previousPlan.retainedEvidence without checks, and `projects:migrate-legacy` stores unknown keys of accepted legacy projects. PlanMilestone is also declared twice (shared/types/index.ts and shared/domain/agent/planMilestone.ts). Next, add a complete AgentPlan schema next to planMilestoneSchema in electron/core/domain/agent/agentTaskContract.ts and parse it in agentIpc.ts, strip unknown project keys in projectRegistryAppService.migrateLegacyProjects, keep one PlanMilestone type, and add negative tests in agentIpc.test.ts.

[P3] ARCH-PORTS-FOLLOWUP-01: after ARCH-LAYERING-01 (2026-09-23) application/domain no longer import electron or node:fs (enforced by scripts/check_layering.mjs), but electron/core/presentation/diagnosticsIpc.ts still calls runFullDiagnostics from electron/diagnostics.ts directly (skipping Application), application services import electron/diagnostics.ts for getCachedGpuInfo/getMemoryInfo/checkOllamaStatus instead of a hardware-probe port, TaskRunnerPort is declared in application/taskAppService.ts and ISkillHubAdapter in infrastructure/http/hubAdapters. Next, move the probes behind a domain port implemented in infrastructure, route diagnostics:run through diagnosticsAppService, move the two port interfaces to electron/core/domain/ports, and extend check_layering.mjs to forbid application imports of electron/diagnostics.ts.

[P3] TRANSLATION-INPLACE-LIFECYCLE-01: src/components/translation/TranslationView.tsx mounts InplaceTranslationPanel only while its tab is open, so switching back to the Markdown tab unmounts useInplaceTranslation, drops its status/progress and releases the 'translation' global task lock while the sidecar job keeps running; the two translators also keep separate language pairs. Next, lift the in-place job state (or keep the panel mounted and hidden) so the lock follows the sidecar job, share the language pair through useTranslationBase in src/hooks/useTranslation.ts, and cover tab switching during a job in a hook test. Sidecar and Main already support cancellation (2026-09-23: the translate task_id is registered in taskRunner as 'translation' and progress events carry taskId), but the panel has no Cancel button; add one that calls cancelTask(taskId) and shows the 'cancelled' outcome.

[P3] TAUTOLOGICAL-TESTS-01: src/lib/frontendPerformance.test.ts re-implements the logic it claims to verify (e.g. 'Grep Search Out-Of-Order Request ID Invariant' simulates a request-id guard for the useGrepSearch hook deleted on 2026-09-23) instead of importing production code, so it cannot fail when the product regresses. Next, audit that file and similar simulation tests, rewrite them against the real hooks/services or delete them, and update the fast-suite counts in AGENTS.md.

[P3] TOOL-POLICY-GUARD-EVENTS-01: calls refused by the phase tool policy ('Tool blocked by current phase') consume steps but are not recorded as guard events and do not count toward any progress budget, so a model that keeps calling a blocked tool only ends on the step budget. Next, add a tool_policy AgentGuardId, record it where the phase policy rejects a call, and decide whether it should feed AgentProgressPolicy (e.g. as a loop block). Evidence: the same full task run spent 8 of its 50 steps on read_file calls denied by the phase policy (verification_failing/focus turns expose only write_file after a version-conflict read), none of them recorded as a guard.

[P3] GIT-DIFF-ENOBUFS-01: the agent git_diff tool (executeGitDiff in electron/core/domain/agent/tools/git/gitCommitTool.ts, GitRun from gitToolService.ts) fails with 'Git Diff Error: spawnSync git ENOBUFS' when the workspace diff exceeds the default 1 MB spawnSync buffer, although it only keeps the first 8000 characters; seen on 2026-09-23 when agentToolExecutorService.test.ts ran git_diff on this repository with the 460-file formatting diff uncommitted. Next, bound the output (e.g. git diff --stat first, or a larger maxBuffer with the partial stdout kept on ENOBUFS) and report truncation, with a unit test on a GitRun that throws ENOBUFS.
